hypotheses.B1_joint64_beats_more_expensive_collapse: Joint rank 64, using 64 sequence-field coordinates, exceeds collapsed rank 1, using 128 positionwise coordinates, by at least 0.30 in every cell.
hypotheses.B2_joint128_beats_coordinate_matched_col: Joint rank 128 and collapsed rank 1 both use 128 runtime coordinates; joint fidelity is at least 0.40 higher in every cell.
hypotheses.B3_joint64_beats_collapsed4_despite_eigh: Joint rank 64 exceeds collapsed rank 4, which uses 512 coordinates, in every cell.
hypotheses.B4_joint64_is_useful_at_early_boundary: Joint rank 64 preserves at least 0.75 Fisher fidelity for every new target at boundary 6.
hypotheses.B5_joint_frontier_is_coordinate_pareto_s: At each tested total coordinate budget up to 128, the best joint program has higher mean fidelity than the best collapsed program that fits that budget.
